title: Temperature below range
shortDescription: Measured temperature below device lower limit.
fullDescription:
Lo appears when the SureTemp or Braun ThermoScan detects a temperature below its operating range (typically 34°C / 93.2°F).

Ensure probe is placed correctly (sublingual, axillary, or tympanic depending on model) and not exposed to cold air.

Safety note: if patient's temperature genuinely is low, check clinically — hypothermia requires immediate attention.

fixSteps.title: Warm probe and reposition
fixSteps.instruction: Let probe reach room temperature; place correctly under tongue, armpit, or ear.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

title: Temperature above range
shortDescription: Measured temperature exceeds device upper limit.
fullDescription:
Hi indicates temperature above 42.2°C / 108°F — the upper limit. This is either severe hyperthermia or a probe contamination issue.

Verify with another thermometer. If genuine, treat as medical emergency.

Safety note: hyperthermia above 40°C requires immediate medical evaluation.

fixSteps.title: Verify
fixSteps.instruction: Allow probe to cool, clean, and retake temperature.

fixSteps.title: Seek care if real
fixSteps.instruction: Contact healthcare provider for high-confirmed readings.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

title: General measurement error
fullDescription:
Err is shown when the thermometer cannot complete a reading due to poor probe contact, movement, or sensor issues.

Ensure probe cover is installed, tip is clean, and placement is correct.

Safety note: do not rely on an Err cycle as a reading — always retake.

fixSteps.title: Install fresh probe cover
fixSteps.instruction: Use a new disposable probe cover and ensure it seats fully.

fixSteps.title: Reposition
fixSteps.instruction: Place under tongue in sublingual pocket or firmly in ear canal.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.q: Why do I need probe covers?
faq.a: Hygiene and proper sensor isolation; missing covers can cause Err.

title: Low battery
shortDescription: Battery power too low for accurate reading.
fullDescription:
batt indicator means battery voltage is insufficient. Readings may be unreliable.

Replace AA batteries in SureTemp 690/692 or charge base for rechargeable units.

Safety note: never take clinical readings with low battery indicator active.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh AA batteries (3 required for SureTemp 690).

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

title: Probe error
fullDescription:
E01 indicates the probe sensor is not communicating properly. This is a hardware-level issue.

Reseat the probe connection. If error persists, replace the probe assembly.

Safety note: do not continue using until resolved — readings may be grossly inaccurate.

fixSteps.title: Reseat probe
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug probe cable from base and reconnect firmly.

fixSteps.title: Replace probe
fixSteps.instruction: Order replacement probe if error persists.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service
videoSearchQuery: welch allyn suretemp E01 probe error

faq.a: Must match model — oral/axillary (blue) vs rectal (red).

title: Ambient out of range
fullDescription:
E02 appears when room temperature is too hot or cold for accurate measurement. Operating range is typically 10-40°C.

Move the device to a climate-controlled area and allow 15 minutes to equilibrate.

Safety note: do not force a reading outside operating range.
whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: The device calibrates readings using ambient baseline.

title: Timeout error
fullDescription:
E03 indicates the thermometer took too long to reach equilibrium, usually from poor probe contact or patient movement.

Ensure probe is firmly in sublingual pocket or deep in axilla, and patient is still.

Safety note: incomplete readings should not be used clinically.

fixSteps.title: Reposition and hold still
fixSteps.instruction: Place probe correctly, keep patient still for full measurement.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.q: How long should a reading take?

title: Internal system error
fullDescription:
E04 indicates an internal fault — memory, CPU, or calibration issue. Device requires service.

Power cycle by removing batteries for 60 seconds. If error persists, contact Welch Allyn or authorized service.

Safety note: do not use clinically until serviced.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Welch Allyn if error persists.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Annual calibration recommended for clinical settings.
